notes.title: v1.0 Upgrade Logs
notes.content:
New
New Map: Ares Space Station.
Party system.
Voice chat system.
Added hp bar for players and zombies.

Improve
Player will be notified if they attack ally, the damage will be reduced by 80%.
Improve the shaders of characters.
Melee attack is now triggered by right mouse button on PC.
Added ruined cars on street, smokes and fires.
Added random sun light system.
Names of items are now displayed in colors distinguished by it’s rarity.
Added option for “Auto-Party”.

- Added option for “Auto-Party”.

notes.title: v0.84 Upgrade Logs
notes.content:
New
Added gas effect in waiting room.
Added shortcut buttons for meds on screen.
Added gas station and more details to the map.

Improve
UI will be hidden when player is aiming.
Bandage won’t heal over 60% health, first aid won’t heal over 80% health.
Increase overall melee damage.
Increase the damage of shotgun slightly.
Reduce the clips of some pistols.
The enemy indication (red dot) now also tells distance.
Player can’t fire if the gun is colliding with any object.

Bug
Fixed a bug that caused guns to shoot at the direction where the gun is not pointing to.
Fixed other known bugs.

notes.title: v0.73 Upgrade Logs

Added bandaging, dead, match start countdown SFX.
Added red dot notification to highlight the stuff player should pay attention to.

Improves the aiming system significantly.
Reduce the bullets per shot by Skull Cracker from 8 to 6.

Bugs

Fixed a bug that caused AK47 and 2 pistols not to be displayed properly.
Fixed a bug that caused exp not to be calculated correctly.
Fixed other known bugs.

Added support for other aspect ratios.	


Improve
Adjusted player camera angle.
Changed open door key to “F”.

Bugs
